about.title: About me
about.description1: Hello! Since the age of 3-4 I've been developing (mainly games, on platforms like the Godot Engine) for entertainment and as a hobby.
about.description2: I'm currently studying a Computer Science Technician, as I'm looking to qualify in what I like and identify with. Meanwhile, I'm looking to improve myself through some private projects, share them on international platforms such as Macondo and Flavortown, and learn different programming languages; to learn and build the future I intend to pursue in the development area.
projects.title: Projects
projects.chess-in-c.title: Chess in C ♙
projects.chess-in-c.description1: Because of a school subject I worked on using the C language, I challenged myself to create a local, two-player chess game (no online matches), in terminal format.
projects.chess-in-c.description2: The game is available at Linux, Mac and Windows, and it has an online test version.
projects.chess-in-c.description3.pre: This game was also published in
projects.chess-in-c.description3.post: , a global programming and challenge platform aimed at teens.
projects.chess-in-c.description4: The game has the following resources:
projects.chess-in-c.feature1: Local chess game for two people;
projects.chess-in-c.feature4: Using ANSI colors to color the board and add special messages;
projects.chess-in-c.feature5: Move verification system faithful to the official chess rules, including special moves such as castling, drowning, etc.;
projects.chess-in-c.alt: Screenshot of the C chess game, showing a colored board and a move request.
projects.geradorabnt.description1: Aiming to facilitate academic research, I developed this system based on the academic citation model of the Brazilian Association of Technical Standards (ABNT).
projects.geradorabnt.description2.pre: It is designed to be simple:
projects.geradorabnt.description2.bold: Enter the link → Get the citation and bibliographic reference ready.
